source: Open-Meteo Marine API (selected marine model not exposed by response)

marine_source_contract.model_identity: provider-selected; not exposed in API response
marine_source_contract.coastal_validity: finite values are not sufficient evidence of local validity; consult wave_component_contract and water-support metadata

quality.atmospheric_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API (temperature_2m, pressure_msl, 10 m wind)
quality.notes: The Open-Meteo Marine API combines several marine models and does not expose the selected model in this response. The API requires equal-length lat/lon arrays; we fetch a 23x23 square over the full operational bbox and bilinearly interpolate to the full display grid. Atmospheric 10-m wind is pulled from api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast on the same grid+timeline.

tide_harmonic_source.method: lazy regional mesh extraction + QC harmonic fit

rejected_constituents.S2: 126-hour fit rejected as ill-conditioned for near-collinear M2/S2 separation

tide_range_definition: full 168-hour harmonic-source max-min; unstable S2 constituent rejected

wave_water_mask_contract.source: native mesh triangles whose three STOFS depth values are finite and positive, intersected with detailed land geometry
wave_water_mask_contract.purpose: wave, swell, wind-wave and significant-wave-height overlays
wave_water_mask_contract.cell_rule: coverage is a diagnostic footprint; partial wet cells retain local water anchors and are rendered with barrier-aware paths
wave_water_mask_contract.open_water_rule: wet pixels connected to the raster boundary through water; this is a conservative geometry support gate, not a shallow-water propagation model
wave_water_mask_contract.raster_row_order: north_to_south; cell arrays are aggregated after north/south flip to forecast south_to_north order

source.method: lazy regional mesh extraction + QC harmonic fit
